blocks.text: Exercises: sentences and translations from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Казу сказал ей, что в ___ (май) поедет в Бразилию.
exercises.prompt: Kazu told her that he would go to Brazil in May.
exercises.why: The names of the months in Russian are not capitalized. They are declined like masculine nouns: сентябрь, октябрь, ноябрь, декабрь, январь, февраль are declined like «словарь». In a date the day is rendered by an ordinal number. Note — in a compound ordinal number only the last word is declined. If the month is not mentioned the word «число» is usually used: *Завтра уже двадцать пятое число.* 3. To state the month only, the nominative is used: *Теперь у нас май, а тогда был февраль. — DLI, Lesson 75.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
exercises.context: The names of the months in Russian are not capitalized. (DLI, Lesson 75)
